summary: Iteration 15 (frontend only, admin, 390x844 + 375x667): Credit card Schedule modal + min-payment fixes ALL PASS. I created TEST_SchedCard through the UI (2400, 20% APR, day 15, 2%, floor 25), edited it, tested it, then deleted it through the UI. Schedule modal: X (close-schedule, 40x40) sits at y=44 on web, where insets are 0 and the code falls back to 20+8 plus 16 inner padding. A real click on it closes the modal. The bottom Close (close-schedule-bottom, 342x45) also closes it and stays visible at the bottom after the table scrolls (y=787 at 844, y=610 at 667). Minimum mode: 304 payments. Custom amount defaults to 96 (2x min) and gives 33 payments; $500 gives 6; $30 shows the 'doesn't cover monthly interest' warning. Months mode with 24 gives $122.15/month and exactly 24 rows, with row 24 ending at $0.00 and no row 25. 0 months shows 'Enter 1–600 months'; 1 month gives $2,440.01. The table scrolls internally (scrollTop 352 of 744). Form: the label reads 'Lowest min ($)', the formula helper text shows, and selectTextOnFocus selects all text on a fresh focus ([0,2] / [0,6] / [0,1]). card-min-floor-warning appears when floor >= balance and hides at 25. Save and edit work. Min payment on the card is $48.00 for 2400/2%/25, and $2,400.00 when the floor was 252525. The user's bug repro was confirmed: when I clicked the already-focused floor field again and typed 25, '2525' became '252525'. Select-all only fires on a fresh focus, and the new warning now catches this case. No deprecated Expo packages and no react-native SafeAreaView imports.

issues: Touch targets under 44pt: card-schedule-{id} is 91x27, card-edit-{id} and card-delete-{id} are 28x28 (cards.tsx:662-672). Add hitSlop or increase the size.
In 'Months to pay off' mode the 'Pay off in' label wraps onto 2 lines at 375px width (customLabel in a row with flex:1 input). Minor.
close-editor X has no padding/hitSlop (22px icon only), which is below the 44pt target (cards.tsx:375).

test_report_links: browser_automation scripts (inline): cards add/edit/warning, schedule modal close/minimum/custom/months, small viewport, delete cleanup
action_items: Optional: add hitSlop/min 44pt size to card-schedule, card-edit, card-delete and close-editor buttons.
Optional: openSchedule does not reset customBy/monthsInput, so the previous card's months mode/value carries over to the next card. Consider resetting them, or keep it if intentional.
Verify on a physical iPhone (Expo Go) that insets.top is non-zero in the fullScreen Modal. Web preview insets are 0, so only the 28px fallback could be tested here.
critical_code_review_comments: cards.tsx is 777 lines (>700). Consider extracting the ScheduleModal and CardEditor into src/components.

selectTextOnFocus only fires on focus. If the field is already focused, typing still appends. The warning mitigates this; a server-side or save-time confirm when min_payment_floor >= balance would be stronger.
Delete errors are swallowed silently (onDelete catch {}). Show an alert.
